subject: Anchored discount structure and on-ramp milestones
messages:
From: Paige Thornton <paige@veridian.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@veridian.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial terms + ask on price match

Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the latency profile and the Dedicated offering looks like a good fit for Veridian's recommendation pipeline. Before we take this to procurement, I wanted to be straightforward: another vendor has offered us a tiered package that is roughly 18% cheaper on list for our expected 24-month consumption.

Can Redwood match that effective rate if we commit to a 12-month reserve with a phased on-ramp (pilot -> production) and an SLA addendum? If you need the competing quote I can share it — procurement asked for line-item comparables.

Also included our procurement alias for ease of routing.

Paige
Paige Thornton
Head of Platform Engineering, Veridian AI
paige@veridian.ai

Attachment: veridian_proposal_061226.pdf (external proposal, PDF, 42KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paige Thornton <paige@veridian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial terms + ask on price match

Paige —

Really appreciate the transparency and the quick follow-up. We'd love to keep Veridian as a customer — the product fit sounds strong. Before we sign off on any match I want to clarify a few constraints so we propose something durable:

- The competing price you quoted — is that net of any non-recurring onboarding credits or limited pilot credits?
- Do you need dedicated GPUs in us-west for the entire term, or are you open to a hybrid stage (pilot on multi-tenant, production on Dedicated)? That affects the anchor SKU.
- Any special data handling or SOC addenda beyond our standard Private deployment terms?

Ben & Neha — looping you in for pricing and contractual feasibility. My suggestion: we can propose an anchored discount structure that includes a performance commitment (latency SLA), staged commit (pilot -> 6mo reserve -> 12mo reserve), and a small onboarding credit. I'll draft a counter that maps line-items to Veridian's quote.

Next step: Paige, can you confirm whether the competitor's number includes a one-time implementation rebate? If yes, we'll produce an apples-to-apples comparison and a Redwood counter.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0182

Attachment: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial terms + ask on price match

Team —

Reviewed Paige's PDF. Quick read: competitor is offering a 3-month pilot credit (one-time) plus a 15% list discount on committed GPUs, but their SLA is 99.5% and network egress is charged separately. Veridian expects steady-state ~200k inference tokens/month initially, scaling to ~600k/month over Q2.

Proposed Redwood counter (high level):
- 12% list discount across Dedicated tiers when signed for 12 months (anchor).
- Additional 4% rebate applied after 6 months if volume meets agreed thresholds (effectively 16% for qualifying customers).
- One-time onboarding credit equivalent to one month's committed spend (to mirror competitor pilot value).
- Include KV-cache prefetch assistance and a deployment workshop (no extra charge).
- SLA: 99.9% for Dedicated, with a limited outage credit schedule (we'll push contractual wording via legal).

We should keep the first pass numeric and show the path to parity rather than immediate deep discounting. I attached an onramp milestones workbook for sequencing.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — West Region | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: onramp-milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet, 8KB)

From: Paige Thornton <paige@veridian.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@veridian.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial terms + ask on price match

Thanks, Ben & Jasmine. Helpful — procurement confirmed competitor credit is indeed a one-time 3-month service credit and their SLA is lower. They care most about effective unit economics over 12 months and a simple on-ramp schedule that doesn’t require upfront heavy ops.

Two clarifications from our side:
- The 4% rebate after 6 months — is that retroactive or prospective? Procurement wants predictability (retroactive is preferred).
- Onboarding credit: they asked whether it can be structured as a fund that’s usable for runbooks and migration assistance rather than a hard credit.

If Redwood can make the rebate retroactive to month 1 (payable at month 6 if thresholds hit) and offer the onboarding fund construct, we'll likely close. Can you turn this into a short counter PDF we can hand to procurement?

Paige

--
Paige Thornton
Head of Platform Engineering, Veridian AI

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paige Thornton <paige@veridian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@veridian.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial terms + ask on price match

Paige —

Thanks for the quick clarity. Attached is a concise counter PDF that aligns with the ask:

- 12% list discount applied immediately on signature (Dedicated).
- Retroactive 4% rebate for months 1–6 if the agreed volume thresholds are met (rebate applied to month 6 invoice).
- Onboarding fund equal to one month's committed spend; funds usable for runbooks/migration/ops consultancy and administrated via a redemption form.
- SLA: 99.9% with standard outage credit schedule; legal will send a short addendum.
- Milestones: pilot kickoff within 14 days, production readiness checklist sign-off at month 2, volume review at month 6.

Ben & Neha — please review the attached counter (redwood_counter_20261209.pdf) and confirm legal language for the retroactive rebate and fund redemption process. Paige — if that reads clean, Contracts can take the PDF and the simple SOW to procurement for final sign-off.

Looking forward to closing this.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
